articles.title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.

articles.title: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest piled into Anthropic IPO, buying $90 million worth of shares
articles.snippet: ARK Invest snapped up $90 million in Anthropic stock across six funds during the AI maker’s historic Nasdaq debut while offloading Nvidia shares amid leadership turmoil.

articles.title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
articles.snippet: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

articles.title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
articles.snippet: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.

articles.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
articles.snippet: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.
